title: Indexed transition actions
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{tr}$ assign an action to each state in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, input read in $\{\text{blank},0,1\}$, and work-tape read pattern, and let $q$ be a state in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$. For any input read $\mathrm{inp}\in\{\text{blank},0,1\}$ and any work-tape read pattern $w$, the action at index $3^k\,\mathrm{rank}(\mathrm{inp})+\mathrm{rank}(w)$ in the list of all transition actions at state $q$ is $\mathrm{tr}(q,\mathrm{inp},w)$, where the input ranks are blank, $0$, $1$ in that order and the work-tape patterns are listed in the recursively defined order.
hypotheses_covered: Transition function tr with the stated input, work-read, state, and action types
